content.thinking:
KeyError on a node id in `decompose` → `self.tarc[node]` KeyError, meaning `node` is not an internal tree node... The walk: `while node not in leaf_slot: la, lb = self.tarc[node]` — if the node has no tarc entry, it's a leaf, but leaf_slot should contain it. Unless the head_arc for a window is the arc (v→w_j) where v is... hmm. `node = g.to[head_arc]` — head_arc is the forward arc index (v→w_j) so g.to[head_arc] = w_j itself, not v! Oops: for a forward arc a: g.to[a] = head = w_j; the tail is g.to[a^1] ✓. So `node = g.to[head_arc ^ 1]` ✓.

Let me fix that.

Also in the walk: `if arcflow[la] > 0: ... node = g.to[la]` — la is the forward arc (child→node) → g.to[la] = child? No: g.to[la] = the head of arc la = node (the parent) ✗. The child = g.to[la ^ 1] ✓ (the reverse arc's target = the tail ✓). Fix both.
